fixtures/cohort.myst:1:1:STROBE.Funding:Give the source of funding and the funders' role (item 22).

fixtures/cohort.myst:9:12:Journals.Intensifiers:Intensifier 'very' adds nothing a number would not.
fixtures/cohort.myst:9:51:Journals.DataPlural:'data' is plural in a manuscript: 'data are', not 'data was'.

fixtures/cohort.myst:13:9:Journals.Prove:Results show or support; 'proves' claims more than data can.
